about: Numbers and word lists of the private check (rule 9). This file cannot switch the check off: it is a safety check.

privateMark.about: Text you put between <private> and </private> is never stored by your notebook's own programs. A write into one of these notes, or a run of one of these programs, that carries the mark is refused. The check keeps its own floor of these lists; this file can add to them, never take away.

ownAccounts._about: Empty out of the box. A search of your own connected mail or drive may carry a protected name only when that connector's one search tool is listed here, whole (^mcp__<connector>__search_...$); any other shape is dropped by the check. Keys and words from private notes are still refused there, and a web search, a fetch, a send, a draft or a share is refused exactly as before. Adding an entry lets more through, so it needs your own words.
